MIT licensed. permalink: /chart/types/line/ doc_section: Chart Reporting doc_section_url: /chart/ generated_by: scripts/split_showcase.py --- {% capture specimen %} {% endcapture %} {% capture snippet %}{% highlight csharp %}{% raw %} string svg = ChartBuilder.Create() .Title("Monthly Website Visitors") .Subtitle("Jan – Dec 2025") .Size(700, 420) .XAxis("Month", "Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun", "Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec") .YAxis("Visitors", min: 0) .AsAnimated() .Series(s => s .AddLine("Visitors", new double[] { 12400, 14800, 16200, 18500, 21000, 19800, 22300, 25100, 23700, 20400, 17900, 15600 })) .RenderToSvg(); {% endraw %}{% endhighlight %}{% endcapture %} {% include chart-type-page.html slug=page.type_slug specimen=specimen snippet=snippet %}
